title: Stage - Coordinateur administratif & opérations événementielles (x/f/m) - janvier 2027
desc:
L'équipe Field Marketing & B2B Events crée des événements pour les professionnels de santé : congrès, événements propres et activations locales. Ils renforcent notre marque et soutiennent directement les équipes Sales. En rejoignant l'équipe, vous devenez le pilier opérationnel qui rend ces événements possibles : vous fiabilisez les inscriptions, la facturation et la logistique, et vous libérez du temps pour que l'équipe se concentre sur ce qui crée le plus de valeur. Vous participez aussi aux événements sur le terrain, comme membre à part entière de l'équipe.

 





VOS MISSIONS

Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :

 - Piloter les inscriptions aux événements : suivre les listes, relancer, mettre à jour les données et assurer le lien avec les équipes Sales.

 - Gérer le cycle de facturation événementielle : bons de commande, suivi des factures fournisseurs, rapprochement avec le budget et relances.

 - Gérer les commandes de goodies et de supports : demandes de devis, commandes, suivi des livraisons et des stocks.

 - Structurer et fiabiliser nos process et nos documents : archivage, templates, tableaux de suivi, automatisation simple de tâches répétitives.

 - Vous préparez un Bac+2 à Bac+5 (BTS ou BUT GEA, assistant manager, gestion administrative, commerce, événementiel).

 - Vous êtes très rigoureux·se et à l'aise avec les chiffres, les tableaux de suivi et les documents administratifs.

 - Vous savez gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle sans perdre de vue les échéances.

 - Vous aimez le contact avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les partenaires.

 - Vous maîtrisez Excel ou Google Sheets



Ce serait fantastique si :

 - Vous avez déjà suivi une facturation ou un budget, même à petite échelle.

 - Vous êtes curieux·se des outils d'automatisation et de gestion de données.

 - Vous utilisez déjà l’IA au quotidien

title: (Junior) CS Operations Manager - Legal and Complaints (m/f/d)
desc:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

We are looking for a dedicated and competent professional to strengthen our team in the area of Solution Management EU, Customer Service. In this role, you will take on complaint handling, primarily for our German-speaking markets. Do you have a knack for de-escalation, work in a structured manner, and keep an overview even in challenging situations? If you want to drive complex cases forward in a solution-oriented manner and enjoy a constructive error culture, we look forward to receiving your application!

Your Responsibilities

• End-to-End Case Management: Independently manage and resolve complex customer complaints and legal cases within deadlines, maintaining a professional, solution-oriented approach even in high-frequency environments.

• Legal Triage & Case Preparation: Screen incoming customer inquiries for legal relevance, escalate sensitive or high-risk cases appropriately, and structure case documentation to support the Legal team’s decision-making.

• GDPR & Regulatory Compliance: Handle data privacy (GDPR) requests end-to-end, ensuring strict compliance, accurate documentation, and timely follow-ups.

• Compliant & Empathetic Communication: You craft clear, empathetic, and comprehensive responses to complaints and legal cases and ensure that every response is also regulatory compliant.

• Risk Assessment & Root Cause Analysis: Identify potential legal or operational risks early, systematically analyze complaint drivers, and initiate sustainable process improvements.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as a key interface between Legal, Product, and Operations to assess, mitigate, and resolve legally complex or operationally challenging customer cases.

Your Profile

• Completed training, ideally in banking and/or legal field (e.g., as a paralegal / legal assistant), or a comparable qualification - career changers with customer service experience are also welcome!

• At least 1-2 years of experience handling customer inquiries with a legal and/or complaint focus, ideally in the financial services industry, customer service, or a similar role.

• Basic knowledge of contract law, data protection law, or commercial law is an advantage – willingness to familiarize yourself with new legal issues is desired.

• Strong understanding of de-escalation strategies as well as the ability to communicate complex issues in an understandable and solution-oriented manner.

• A strong ability to prioritize correctly even with high ticket volumes and to comply with Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

• A high sense of responsibility, teamwork skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

• Minimum C2 fluency (written and spoken) in German is required, along with good working proficiency in English (C1). Any additional language skills are a strong plus.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

• Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

• Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

• A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.

• Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month.

• Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.

• Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.

• Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.

• You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.

Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy

We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

• Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce) and office tools (Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint/Google Slides).

title: Legal Affairs Intern - Contracts & Legal Operations
desc:
At SOPHiA GENETICS, we are building the future of AI-assisted, data-driven medicine. Our technology helps healthcare professionals make sense of complex data, with the ambition of improving outcomes for patients with cancer and rare diseases.
Behind our technology is a Legal team supporting the business, managing contracts and navigating an evolving regulatory environment.
And we're looking for someone curious to discover how it all works.
Join our Legal Affairs team in Bidart, France, for a six-month internship and gain practical experience in commercial contracting, legal operations and the use of AI in legal processes.
You'll support our Legal team in its daily activities while contributing to projects involving commercial contracts and legal technology.

• Work on commercial contracts. Assist with drafting, reviewing and updating contracts and amendments under the guidance of experienced colleagues.
• Explore AI in legal operations. Contribute to improving our biopharma commercial contract templates and an AI-assisted contract review tool.
• Conduct legal research. Help monitor legal and regulatory developments relevant to our business.
• Support everyday legal activities. Assist with administrative tasks, document preparation and the organization of legal information.
• Learn how legal processes work. Discover how contracts are managed and how the Legal team collaborates with different business functions.
Requirements
You might be studying Law at Bachelor's or Master's level, with an interest in commercial law, contract management or legal technology.
We'd be happy to hear from you if:

• You're curious about business and technology, particularly how AI can support legal work.
• You have good research and writing skills and enjoy working with legal documents.
• You're comfortable with Microsoft Office and AI tools, and interested in learning new systems.
• You're organized and attentive to detail, with a careful approach to your work.
• You enjoy working with others, ask questions and are motivated to learn.
Previous experience in a legal department is welcome, but your enthusiasm, curiosity and willingness to learn are just as important.
Start date: March 2027
Benefits

• Hands-on experience in commercial contracting and legal operations within an international healthcare technology company.
• The opportunity to explore AI-assisted contract review and legal technology.
• Guidance from experienced Legal Affairs colleagues.
• Opportunities to connect with colleagues across the business and participate in company activities.
• A paid internship, in line with our local internship practices.

title: Product Management Intern
desc:
Company Description
Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.
Nexthink Spark is our personal IT agent for every employee. Launched in January 2026 on the Nexthink Infinity platform, Spark is an autonomous AI agent that uses real-time device data, AI-driven diagnostics and IT-approved automations to resolve employees’ IT issues directly in the conversation, often without a ticket ever being created. With Spark, we are on a journey to transform IT support into an AI-first experience: from support agent to concierge for every employee. Our ambition is to give every employee a personal IT concierge that understands their digital environment, anticipates issues and helps them get the most out of their tools, instead of waiting in a ticket queue.
#Li-Hybrid

Job Description
As an intern you will join the Spark product management team and work on features that reach enterprise customers. You will help take Spark features from definition to release: writing requirements and user stories, working with engineering, design and AI teams, preparing release communication and documentation, and tracking adoption after launch. You will also analyse Spark usage data (conversations, resolution and escalation rates, adoption by channel) to understand how employees use the agent and where it falls short, and turn these findings into concrete improvement proposals that you present to the product team and leadership.
This internship offers hands on experience in building and shipping an agentic AI product used by large enterprises, analysing real production data, and the full product management cycle in a global software company: discovery, prioritisation, release and impact measurement.
You will gain experience in how LLM-based agents are designed, evaluated and improved; turning data into product decisions; working with cross-functional, international teams; and presenting your work to senior stakeholders. You will be coached by experienced product managers and own a clearly defined scope from start to finish.

Qualifications
Required Skills

• Student in computer science, data science, engineering, business analytics or a related field.
• A genuine interest in product management: you enjoy listening to customers and users, identifying the real problem behind a request, and working with the team to find the best solution.
• Strong analytical skills.
• Structured problem-solving: you can break down an ambiguous problem, weigh options and make a clear, reasoned recommendation, and communicate it well in written and spoken English.
• Technical curiosity and ownership: you are comfortable working with engineers, want to understand how an AI agent works under the hood, and follow a topic through to delivery.
Nice to have

• Interest in, or hands-on experience with, LLMs, AI agents or prompt engineering.
• Prior internship or project in product management, consulting or a startup.

Additional Information
We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.
With over 1200 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.
